product_overview: Payment Gateway CLI is a TypeScript-based tool and SDK designed to integrate billing systems with Discord role management, enabling seamless invoice, plan, and refund handling via CLI commands, REST API, and webhooks.
core_goals: Provide a robust command-line interface for full billing lifecycle management including plans, invoices, refunds, and Discord integration.
Offer a comprehensive Node.js SDK for easy integration of billing operations within external applications.
Deliver a secure and scalable REST API server supporting CRUD operations for plans, invoices, refunds, and webhook event handling.
Automate Discord role assignments based on billing statuses and process payment notifications efficiently.
Maintain high code quality through a comprehensive testing framework with unit, integration, and API tests.
key_features: CLI Interface with commands for plan management, invoice operations, refund processing, webhook utilities, and Discord billing integration.
TypeScript SDK providing API clients for plans, invoices, refunds, and webhooks with robust error handling and retry mechanisms.
REST API server built with Express.js exposing billing endpoints including plans, invoices, refunds, and webhook management with security features such as API key authentication and rate limiting.
Discord integration layer that listens to webhook events, manages role assignments/removals, and sends payment status notifications to Discord servers.
Webhook system with event processing, signature verification, and secure Discord notifications to ensure trustworthy billing event handling.
Mock API server and extensive Jest test suite for development, testing, and validation of all billing and integration features.
Security implementations including CORS protection, Helmet security headers, rate limiting, and webhook signature verification to safeguard services.
user_flow_summary: User runs CLI commands to create, update, list, or delete billing plans, invoices, and refunds.
Developers integrate the Node.js SDK in their applications to interact programmatically with billing APIs.
Clients interact with the REST API server for billing-related CRUD operations and webhook event management over authenticated and secure endpoints.
The webhook system receives payment events, verifies signatures, and triggers Discord role assignments/removals and notifications accordingly.
Developers use the mock API server and run automated tests to ensure the reliability of billing integrations before deployment.
validation_criteria: CLI commands perform expected billing operations and provide meaningful feedback to users.
SDK client methods successfully call corresponding API endpoints and handle errors gracefully including retries.
REST API endpoints conform to specification, enforce authentication, and respond within performance benchmarks.
Discord roles are assigned/removed automatically reflective of the billing status changes triggered by webhook events.
Webhook events are validated via signature checks and processed correctly without loss or duplication.
Comprehensive test coverage is achieved including unit tests, integration tests, and API tests with Jest.
Security measures such as rate limiting, CORS, helmet headers, and webhook signature verification are operational and tested.
Deployment scripts build and start the services correctly with environment-based configurations and health endpoints accessible.
